title: Deal drops Anker’s 20,000mAh Travel Essential power bank to just $59.99
summary: Save 14% on the Anker Travel Essential power bank, a 20,000mAh charger with 87W output and a built-in USB-C cable.
body: Running low on battery while traveling is a pain, especially when you also have to carry extra cables for your phone, tablet, or laptop. That’s why this Amazon deal on the Anker Power Bank 20,000mAh Travel Essential is worth a look, with the portable charger down to $59.99. See the deal at Amazon
